     use in assessment (Annex 2) and be able to justify the rationale for usage. If students are not

     exception must be approved by School Education Committee.

topics.title: Privacy and data
topics.summary: Students must not be required to upload personal data to non-Keele GenAI systems. Staff and students must not upload copyright-protected content to GenAI tools.
topics.scope: Assessment and Feedback Code sections 4.6–4.8; preserve audience and system limits.

claims.text: Students must not be required to upload personal data to non-Keele GenAI systems. Staff and students must not upload copyright-protected content to GenAI tools.

evidence.quote:
4.6   Students must not be required to upload personal data to non-Keele tools and systems that use
      GenAI as part of an assessment as this may compromise students’ intellectual property and
      personal data rights.

4.7   Staff must not submit student work to non-Keele tools and systems that use GenAI detection
      software or use non-Keele GenAI tools to check the authenticity of student work as this may
      compromise students’ intellectual property and personal data rights.

4.8   Staff and students must not upload copyright protected content to GenAI tools.

privacy_data.meaningEn: Assessment and Feedback Code sections 4.6–4.8; preserve audience and system limits.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 考核与反馈守则第 4.6–4.8 节，保留对象和系统范围。

approved_tools.en: Microsoft Copilot is the institutional tool available without a separate charge to staff and students through Keele IT accounts.
approved_tools.zh: Microsoft Copilot 是师生通过 Keele IT 账户使用、无额外个人收费的机构工具。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Institutional access; each assessment’s permission and actual account activation remain separate.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 机构访问范围；考核许可与实际账户开通须分别确认。

research_publication.en: The reviewed education framework does not establish a complete research, thesis or journal-publication AI policy.
research_publication.zh: 本次教育框架不足以确定完整科研、学位论文或期刊发表 AI 政策。
research_publication.meaningEn: Research-specific authorship, disclosure and data approvals remain evidence gaps.
research_publication.meaningZh: 科研专属署名、披露和数据批准仍有证据缺口。

academic_integrity.en: Suspected GenAI misuse in assessment follows the plagiarism category, rather than contract cheating. Conflicting appeal timing and recipient descriptions remain unresolved.
academic_integrity.zh: 涉嫌考核生成式 AI 误用按抄袭类别处理，而非代写类别；申诉期限算法及收件人描述的差异仍未解决。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Assessment Code section 4.9 and misconduct/appeal sources; do not invent a unified deadline.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 考核守则第 4.9 节及违规、申诉来源；不编造统一期限。

teaching_guidance.en: Staff must not submit student work to non-Keele GenAI detection tools; assessment design must preserve accessible and equitable tool use.
teaching_guidance.zh: 教职员工不得向非 Keele 生成式 AI 检测工具提交学生作品，考核设计须保障可访问性与公平使用。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Assessment Code sections 4.5–4.7; not a ban on every approved institutional detection or comparison system.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 考核守则第 4.5–4.7 节；不扩大成禁止所有获批校内检测或比对系统。

security_procurement.en: Assessment must not require students to buy tools or create new accounts; other AI tools must consider accessibility, GDPR and data privacy.
security_procurement.zh: 考核不得要求学生购买工具或新建账户；其他 AI 工具须考虑可访问性、GDPR 与数据隐私。
security_procurement.meaningEn: Assessment-access conditions; no complete procurement workflow was established here.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 考核访问条件；本次未核实完整采购流程。

scope.en: Use the source-specific audience, assessment and publication limits below. Institution-wide policy review remains PARTIAL.
scope.zh: 请按下列来源的对象、考核及发表范围使用信息，整校政策审核仍为 PARTIAL。

do.en: Acknowledge and cite GenAI use as required by your assessment.
do.zh: 按考核要求说明并引用生成式 AI 使用。

dont.en: Do not upload copyright-protected content to GenAI tools.
dont.zh: 不得向生成式 AI 工具上传受版权保护内容。

Microsoft Copilot.description: Microsoft Copilot 是师生通过 Keele IT 账户使用、无额外个人收费的机构工具。
Microsoft Copilot.howToObtain: 机构访问范围；考核许可与实际账户开通须分别确认。 Microsoft Copilot 是师生通过 Keele IT 账户使用、无额外个人收费的机构工具。
